# Consultim-IT

> An AI-driven Microsoft partner and digital services company (ESN) founded in 2015,
> headquartered in Tunisia with an office in France. Consultim-IT builds AI into what it
> delivers and uses AI in how it delivers, covering enterprise AI, Microsoft 365, document
> management, cybersecurity, licensing, managed services and custom development.

## Languages
- English: https://consultim-it.com/
- Français: https://consultim-it.com/fr/
- Deutsch: https://consultim-it.com/de/

## Key facts
- Founded: 2015 | Legal entity: Consultim-IT SARL (independent)
- Offices: Av Yasser Arafet, RÉS Berrich, Sousse 4054, Tunisia | 23 boulevard de l'Europe, 68100 Mulhouse, France
- Contact: business@consultim-it.com | +216 98 75 39 75
- Delivery languages: French, English, Arabic | Site languages: English, French, German
- Time zone: Central European Time
- Track record: 100+ projects delivered across 8+ countries
- Sectors: telecommunications, development banking, insurance, public sector,
  international organisations, energy, industry and manufacturing, agri-food

## Solutions (English URLs; /fr/ and /de/ mirror every page)
- [Your data. Your AI. Your control.](https://consultim-it.com/solution-ai.html): Move from AI experimentation to agents and retrieval systems that work with your organisation's real information, permissions and processes — on the cloud or entirely on your own infrastructure.
- [Eliminate manual work.](https://consultim-it.com/solution-automation.html): We analyse business processes, simplify them, automate the repetitive activities and integrate the systems your employees already use.
- [Connect people, information and processes.](https://consultim-it.com/solution-workplace.html): We bring SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Exchange, Entra ID and Power Platform together into a workplace that actually coheres — and we handle the migration to get there.
- [From documents to actionable intelligence.](https://consultim-it.com/solution-ged.html): A document management platform fully integrated with AI: capture, OCR, automatic classification, extraction, natural-language search, controlled workflow, audit trail and archival.
- [If you can describe it, we can build it.](https://consultim-it.com/solution-apps.html): Custom applications, startup products, public-facing platforms, digital commerce and internal tools — with any integration, on cloud, on-premises or hybrid infrastructure. Boosted by AI, built to market best practices.
- [Know where you stand. Then fix it.](https://consultim-it.com/solution-security.html): A structured Microsoft security practice: proprietary assessment tooling, seven packaged workshops, pilot validation and full deployment — delivered by our dedicated cybersecurity team.

## Services
- [Support Desk & Managed Services](https://consultim-it.com/managed-services.html): From SLA-based incident support for your internal IT team, to full tenant administration, governance and continuous improvement.
- [Microsoft Licensing](https://consultim-it.com/licensing.html): Microsoft licence advisory, procurement and lifecycle management — from a partner that also architects and operates the platforms those licences run.
- [Nearshore & multi-region delivery](https://consultim-it.com/engineering.html): Consultim-IT has delivered Microsoft and custom engineering since 2015 from Tunisia, with an office in France — for clients across Europe, the Gulf and Africa.
